headline: Enhance ClearInstall with AI-driven Risk Analysis
summary: Integrate public trend signals to improve the accuracy of risk detection in npm/PyPI packages, ensuring safer local-first installations. Leverage AI for real-time updates and enhanced binding.gyp command expansion checks.
actions: Implement machine learning models based on recent trends (e.g., agent_skills) to predict potential risks associated with package bindings and commands.
Utilize natural language processing techniques from Claude-Cage to analyze package descriptions and community feedback for additional risk insights.
Integrate real-time update mechanisms using superagent-prototype to ensure ClearInstall stays up-to-date with the latest package information and trends.
